description: This file defines a React component named TaskBoard, which implements a Kanban-style task management board. It uses drag-and-drop functionality to move tasks between columns such as 'Todo', 'In-Progress', and 'Done'. It also filters tasks based on search and filter criteria, and provides UI elements for editing, creating, and deleting tasks.

methods.name: priorityTone
methods.description: Determines the tone (style) for a task's priority badge based on its priority level.

methods.name: filterTasks
methods.description: Filters a list of tasks based on search text and filter criteria such as status, priority, tags, and due date window.
